title: Turning the Tables: Modeling the Fight against Ebola

limitations: OCR damages Greek symbols and mobility expressions.
Results are explicitly qualitative because data are incomplete.

task_reconstruction.source: Abstract, Introduction, Sections 2-4, Appendices, WHAMO memo
deliverables: Model progression at individual, regional, mobility, and supply layers.
Test vaccine/cure efficacy, quantity, frequency, and rural/urban targeting.
Assess sensitivity to initial infection, beds, scale, mobility, and regional parameters.
Return qualitative deployment recommendations and future data needs.
task_reconstruction.reconstruction_limit: No separate official statement located; prose reconstructs deliverables and never reclassifies path-derived A.

section_map.summary: Layered model, qualitative scope, and tentative strategy.
Objectives, layers, mobility, supply, implementation, complexity.
Toy tests, spatial allocations, regional variation, limitations.

contributions.summary: Combines individual states, regional graph, mobility, and supply logistics.
Modified gravity includes population, distance, and confidence.
Hub-and-spoke logistics is separate from human mobility.
Rural/urban vaccine and cure scenarios are compared.
Treatment-specific deployment advice is returned with uncertainty.

dependency_graph.closure_status: Layered model -> experiments -> qualitative guidance; no calibrated quantitative policy forecast.

assumptions.summary: Modeled regions are the whole system.
Available data are treated as accurate despite incompleteness.
No averaging assumed despite stochastic variation.

data_and_preprocessing.summary: Modified gravity constants match Guinea microdata.

results_trace.summary: Initial cases change spike more than qualitative trajectory.
Targeting depends on outbreak geography and mobility.
Curative targeting protects via treatment and spillover reduction.

writing_logic.summary: Layered model -> factors -> qualitative boundary -> strategy.
Crisis -> scarcity -> prior models -> tool gap.
Objectives -> scope -> layers -> mobility -> supply -> implementation -> complexity.
Toy baseline -> sensitivities -> allocations -> regional heterogeneity.

language_observations.summary: Capability statements alternate with uncertainty boundaries.
Ordinal scenario setup precedes four-panel comparison.
Policy distinguishes mechanisms and target geography.

judge_relevance_hypotheses.summary: Qualitative boundary and mechanism-linked advice may aid auditability; award status is not causal proof.

weaknesses.summary: Large coupled parameter set and unreliable data block quantitative conclusions.
Guinea constants transferred to two countries without comparable data.
Percentage distribution can create vaccine sinks.

independent_extensions.summary: Calibrate geography-resolved graph with time-varying wet-season edges and observed mobility.
Optimize hubs and allocation laws under capacity, equity, routing, and stock constraints.

unresolved_questions: Random seeds, repetitions, and confidence intervals are incompletely specified.
Modified gravity normalization is partly OCR-damaged.
Vaccine equity, hospital capacity, and containment are not jointly optimized.
Self-limiting behavior may depend on closed-world and high-mortality assumptions.
Appendix ODEs are not quantitatively calibrated to the discrete simulator.
